name: layout
need: Arrange parts without page CSS: a row that wraps, a side and main column, equal parts, a centred column, a full-height cover, a media frame, an auto-fit grid

--ds-cluster-gap.description: the gap of `.ds-cluster`, 2px less per density step

--ds-split-gap.description: the gaps of `.ds-split`, `.ds-switcher` and `.ds-grid`, 2px less per density step

--ds-switcher-gap.description: the gaps of `.ds-split`, `.ds-switcher` and `.ds-grid`, 2px less per density step

--ds-grid-gap.description: the gaps of `.ds-split`, `.ds-switcher` and `.ds-grid`, 2px less per density step

--ds-split-side.description: the width of `.ds-split__side` while it sits beside the main column

--ds-split-min.description: the narrowest `.ds-split__main` beside the side; narrower, the two stack

--ds-switcher-at.description: the width of `.ds-switcher` under which its parts stack

--ds-measure-pad.description: the side padding of `.ds-measure`, outside its width

--ds-frame-ratio.description: the aspect ratio of `.ds-frame` without a ratio modifier

--ds-grid-min.description: the narrowest column of `.ds-grid` (never wider than the grid)
